title: getnao/nao
friendlyTitle: nao lets teams ask questions about their own data
summary: An open-source analytics agent that builds context around company data and provides a chat interface for querying it. It supports common data platforms and self-hosted deployment.
friendlySummary: This open-source analytics agent connects business data to a chat interface so people can ask questions in everyday language.
whyItMatters: Data teams can use it to create a conversational analytics layer over warehouses such as BigQuery, Snowflake or Postgres, while keeping the context and deployment under their control.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it to give more people access to company data without making every question wait for a custom report.
